title: Pope Leo XIV Continues Recovery Following Lung Surgery
subtitle: Vatican officials share positive updates as global leaders watch the health of the 71-year-old leader.

summary.en: Pope Leo XIV is currently recovering in a hospital after a successful surgery to remove a cancerous nodule from his lung. The Vatican reported that the Pope had a good second night following the procedure. While his recovery is ongoing, some international leaders have suggested the process might take longer than originally expected. This update follows previous reports confirming the Pope's diagnosis of adenocarcinoma. His family is also facing health challenges, with reports that his brother is currently receiving treatment for cancer.
summary.zh: 教宗利奧十四世目前正在醫院休養，此前他成功接受了切除肺部癌性結節的手術。梵蒂岡報告稱，教宗在術後第二個夜晚狀況良好。儘管他正在持續康復中，但一些國際領袖暗示這個過程可能比最初預期的更長。這項更新是在先前確認教宗罹患腺癌的報導之後發布的。他的家人也面臨健康挑戰，據報導他的哥哥目前正在接受癌症治療。

paragraphs.en: Pope Leo XIV remains in a Rome hospital as he continues his recovery from surgery. The 71-year-old leader underwent an operation to remove a cancerous nodule—a small growth—from his lung earlier this week. According to the Vatican, the Pope had a "good" second night in the hospital following the procedure. This latest update provides a sense of stability as the public continues to monitor the health of the leader.
paragraphs.zh: 教宗利奧十四世（Pope Leo XIV）目前仍待在羅馬的一家醫院，持續從手術中恢復。這位七十一歲的領袖本週稍早接受了一項手術，切除肺部的一個癌性結節，也就是一種小型腫瘤。根據梵蒂岡的說法，教宗在術後的第二個夜晚狀況「良好」。這項最新消息為持續關注教宗健康的民眾帶來了一種穩定的感覺。

paragraphs.en: This news follows a series of reports regarding the Pope's medical journey. Last week, officials confirmed that doctors discovered a growth on his lung, which was later identified as adenocarcinoma, a type of cancer. The surgery was performed to remove the mass, and initial reports from the hospital suggested that his recovery was following the expected plan. In the days immediately after the operation, staff noted that he had already begun walking, which is often a positive sign for patients recovering from major surgery.
paragraphs.zh: 這則消息是在一系列關於教宗醫療歷程的報導之後發布的。上週，官員證實醫師在他的肺部發現了一個腫瘤，隨後確認為腺癌，這是一種癌症。手術的目的是移除該腫瘤，醫院最初的報告顯示他的恢復狀況符合預期。在手術後的幾天內，工作人員指出他已經開始行走，這對於剛經歷大型手術的患者來說，通常是一個正面的跡象。

paragraphs.en: However, the path to full health may be complex. While the Vatican has shared positive news about his recent nights in the hospital, other voices have offered a more cautious view. According to NBC News, the president of Peru suggested that the Pope's recovery could take "longer than expected." This difference in perspective highlights the uncertainty that often follows serious medical procedures, even when early signs are encouraging.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，完全康復的過程可能相當複雜。儘管梵蒂岡分享了關於他近期在醫院度過良好夜晚的正面消息，但其他聲音則提供了較為謹慎的觀點。根據美國國家廣播公司新聞網（NBC News）報導，秘魯總統暗示教宗的恢復期可能比預期更長。這種觀點上的差異凸顯了即使早期跡象令人鼓舞，重大醫療程序後往往仍伴隨著不確定性。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the immediate news of the Pope's health, there is also information regarding his family. CBS News reports that the Pope’s older brother is currently battling multiple myeloma, a type of blood cancer. He is reportedly enrolled in a clinical trial—a research study to test new medical treatments—at a hospital in Florida. This situation has brought additional attention to the health challenges facing the Pope's family during this difficult time.
paragraphs.zh: 除了教宗健康的直接消息外，也有關於他家人的資訊。哥倫比亞廣播公司新聞網（CBS News）報導，教宗的哥哥目前正在對抗多發性骨髓瘤，這是一種血癌。據報導，他正在佛羅里達州的一家醫院參加臨床試驗，這是一項測試新醫療療法的研究。這種情況讓外界更加關注教宗家人在這個艱難時刻所面臨的健康挑戰。

paragraphs.en: As the Pope continues to rest, the global community remains attentive to any further announcements from the Vatican. The medical team has not yet provided a specific date for his discharge, as they are likely focusing on ensuring he regains his strength in a controlled environment. The recovery process from lung surgery typically requires careful monitoring to prevent complications and to ensure that the patient can return to their normal duties safely.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著教宗持續休養，全球社群仍密切關注梵蒂岡發布的任何進一步公告。醫療團隊尚未提供具體的出院日期，因為他們可能正專注於確保他在受控的環境中恢復體力。肺部手術的恢復過程通常需要謹慎監控，以預防併發症並確保患者能安全地回到正常職務。

paragraphs.en: This situation serves as a reminder of the personal challenges faced by public figures. While the Pope is a global leader, his current health struggle is a human one that many people can understand. The Vatican is expected to release further updates as his condition improves. For now, the focus remains on his comfort and the steady progress of his healing process.
paragraphs.zh: 這種情況提醒了大眾，公眾人物也面臨著個人的挑戰。雖然教宗是一位全球領袖，但他目前的健康掙扎是許多人都能理解的人性問題。預計梵蒂岡將隨著他的病情好轉發布進一步的更新。目前，焦點仍放在他的舒適度以及療癒過程的穩定進展上。

paragraphs.en: In the broader context of health news, the Pope's situation is one of many stories currently being followed by medical observers. From the management of chronic conditions to the development of new treatments for rare diseases, the medical community continues to work on improving patient outcomes worldwide. The attention given to the Pope's recovery reflects his significant role on the world stage and the public's desire to see him return to health. As the days pass, the world waits to see how the Pope’s recovery will progress and when he might be able to resume his official responsibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 在更廣泛的健康新聞背景下，教宗的情況是醫療觀察家目前關注的眾多故事之一。從慢性病的管理到罕見疾病新療法的開發，醫療界持續致力於改善全球病患的治療成果。大眾對教宗康復的關注，反映了他在世界舞台上的重要角色，以及民眾希望看到他恢復健康的願望。隨著日子一天天過去，世界正等待著教宗的康復進度，以及他何時能恢復履行公務。

quiz.question: What specific activity did hospital staff observe that indicated a positive sign for the Pope's recovery?

options.A: He was able to eat a full meal on his second night.
options.B: He began walking shortly after the surgery.
options.C: He was able to sit up and speak with his doctors.
options.D: He successfully completed a series of breathing exercises.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，文中明確提到「staff noted that he had already begun walking, which is often a positive sign for patients recovering from major surgery」。選項 A、C、D 雖然在醫療情境中很常見，但文中並未提及這些具體行為，屬於無中生有的干擾選項。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why might the public's expectations regarding the Pope's recovery timeline be conflicted?

options.A: Because the Pope's family has requested privacy regarding his medical status.
options.B: Because the Vatican and international news outlets are reporting different types of cancer.
options.C: Because official Vatican updates suggest steady progress while external sources suggest a more complicated recovery.
options.D: Because the medical team is intentionally withholding information to prevent public panic.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第三段提到梵蒂岡對住院情況持正面態度，但 NBC 引述秘魯總統的說法，認為恢復期可能比預期更長，顯示出官方與外部觀點之間的落差。選項 A 文章未提及隱私要求；選項 B 錯誤，因為兩者皆指向肺部癌症；選項 D 雖然提到未給出出院日期，但並未說明是為了「防止恐慌」而隱瞞。

quiz.question: In the context of the final paragraph, what does the word 'resume' mean?

options.A: To begin again after a pause.
options.B: To summarize the main points of a report.
options.C: To increase the intensity of an activity.
options.D: To permanently end a professional role.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文章最後一段提到「resume his official responsibilities」，意指教宗在休養後恢復履行其職責，即「重新開始」。選項 B 是 resume (名詞，履歷) 的常見誤解；選項 C 與 D 皆不符合該動詞在文中表達「恢復工作」的語境。
